label: Sweet lassi
note: Made from set dahi, with its mesophilic starter, not from thermophilic yoghurt; sugar is stirred in instead of salt

about.text: Sweet lassi is the sweet form of lassi, a drink of dahi stirred with water and sugar and served chilled, popular in Punjab and Haryana. Fruit such as mango is often blended in.

how.label: dilute, sweeten
how.text: Set dahi is beaten smooth with cold water and sugar; nothing is churned out of it, so the fat stays in (unlike chaas).
